fusions.name: Burst from the Brine
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to the target and strike for 12 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Warren Drumming
fusions.desc: Drums the seabed, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, each with a 25% chance to be [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Into the Burrow
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Quick Calcify
fusions.desc: You move 12% faster and have 8% physical resistance.
